title: Writing --- Four Lines And The Comma You Cannot Hear
label: ch:ru-four-lines
canDo: I can write four connected lines to a named reader, joining with и, но or а and giving a reason with потому что, with a comma in front of every joiner that takes one.

payoff.summary: Complete RU-W260-four-lines: four lines to one reader using и, но or а, and потому что, then check the comma in front of each joiner.
payoff.note: French's parce que moves nothing and German's weil moves the verb; Russian marks the join on paper instead. A comma stands before но, а and потому что and none before и joining two halves about the same person, so the ear never hears the join and the examiner always sees it.
